# XDMOD Manual

2026, XDMOD Manual

- [Variant rules](variants.html.md): Rules for the feature model (F), the product models (V) and the traces of variants (T). Iteration 1 ...
- [Check principles](checks.html.md): General rules that the hygiene and generated-file checks enforce.
